dialogues.speaker: Najah
dialogues.text: Wow, the competitor that made it to the semifinals isn't part of the Amurta, but still had such high compatibility with her Fungi. I suppose logic doesn't apply to the legendary student!

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Ah, if it isn't the renowned Golden Comet and Silver Companion in the flesh!

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Didn't you guys just have a friendly match against her?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Is that Layla's nickname? Can you tell us some more about it...?

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: So you guys don't know her very well, huh? All I know about her are the rumors that I've heard...

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Legend has it that she would appear in various places in the dead of night... carefully observing the constellations. She's capable of swiftly moving between the points of observation and able to travel long distances with ease...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds weird... Something must've been wrong with their eyes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Layla doesn't exactly have the greatest stamina. It's impossible for her to do something like that!

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: I'm just sharing what I heard with you. As for whether the rumors are true... Well, that's none of my business. If you know more about her, feel free to tell me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, it's not appropriate to tell others about someone without their consent... Go and become Layla's friend if you want to get to know her better.

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Hah! You two really are polite, stand-up people!

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: It doesn't matter if it's true or not, it's merely a passing conversation. There's no need to invest time in proving it.

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Sumeru is a big place. We belong to different Darshans and most likely won't cross paths again. We definitely won't meet again after this competition ends...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Be that as it may... It still sounds a little cold...

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: It's highly unlikely that we will. Goodbye, champion candidates.
